text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Shaw Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Shaw Street.

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate an on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Shaw Street, between a point 51 metres south of Queen Street West and a point 5.5 metres further south.
